nameOrigin: hard object in the mouth for biting/chewing food

pokedexEntries.di: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

pokedexEntries.prl: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.

pokedexEntries.pt: A comparison revealed that BIDOOF’s front teeth grow at the same rate as RATTATA’s.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It lives in groups by the water. It chews up boulders and trees around its nest with its incisors.
